_comment: Hamina's OpenIntent export writes only walls + wall materials, not obstacle
geometry, so obstacles (cars, shelving, appliances, foliage, ...) are supplied
here and merged onto the matching floorplan at import time.
floorplan : floorplan name as it appears in the export (omit if single-floor)
material  : obstacle material/type; mapped to an InnerSpace attenuation
Many plain-English aliases resolve (wardrobe, fridge, rack, ...);
anything unknown falls back to cubicles with a warning.
unit      : 'pixels' (default) or 'meters' — both measured from the image
TOP-LEFT corner, x right / y down, i.e. the coordinates you
read straight off an image editor. (wall_segments in the
export use bottom-left/y-up; the importer flips these for you.)
